articles.title: Sky Quarry Enters Production Phase at Nevada's Only Refinery

articles.summary: Nevada imports over 90% of its fuel despite 1.4B barrels underground. Sky Quarry launches drilling in Railroad Valley, aiming to feed Foreland refinery.
articles.title: Sky Quarry Pushes to Expand Drilling in Nevada, Home to an Estimated 1.4 Billion Barrels of Oil
